item.title: Visa, Mastercard, Major Banks Facing New Litigation over 'Anticompetitive' Fees
item.description: A class action lawsuit alleges Visa, Mastercard and some of America's largest banks have conspired to artificially inflate merchants' credit card transaction fees. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Show HN: Bigwords.page – Turn any screen into a sign. The URL is the app
item.description: Turn a phone, tablet or TV into a sign. Type a message and it fills the screen: welcome signs, timers, Wi-Fi passwords and more. No app, no account, free. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Janet on x32: 32-bit Pointers, 64-bit Speed, 25% Less RAM

item.title: Animated ASCII Art for Web Pages
item.description: 191 animated ascii pieces for web pages, in TypeScript with no dependencies: for React, Next.js, Astro, or one HTML tag. MIT licensed. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: A font recreated from photographs of classic Commodore 64 keycaps
item.description: Photo-based reconstruction of classic Commodore 64 keycap lettering, with desktop fonts, webfont, editable outlines, and a specimen. - szabadkai/c64-keyboard-font (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026 to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai
item.description: The Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026 was awarded to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai “for the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.” (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: AnyPS5: Port PS5 binaries to PC without emulation (87% system libraries mapped)
item.description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows - boykopovar/AnyPS5 (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: The Async Multiprocessing Has Sound Foundations in Linux, But Further Testing Is Needed
item.description: At Embedded Linux Conference Europe 2026, Wolfram Sang discussed the Linux building blocks for asymmetric multiprocessing (AMP). (1 source: infoq)
